name: Commerce Stripe Klarna
description: Provides Commerce integration for Stripe Klarna payments via Stripe PaymentIntents, as an offsite gateway.
project_description:
Synopsis 
 This module is a standalone integration of Klarna as a Stripe payment method

 Requirements 
 - drupal/core: ^8.8 || ^9

 - drupal/commerce : ^2.19

 - stripe/stripe/php: ^7.25

 Installation 
 Add this module via composer

 composer require 'drupal/commerce_stripe_klarna:^1.0' 

 Configuration 
 - Go to admin/commerce/config/payment-gateways

 - Click on add a new payment gateway.

 - Find Commerce Klarna Stripe

 - Add your Stripe credentials

 - For US implementation the Stripe account needs to be in the US and currency needs to be USD

 - Other countries supported are: AT, BE, DE, DK, ES, FI, GB, IE, IT, NL, NO, SE, FR, EE, GR, LV, LT, SK, SI.

 - Other currencies supported are: EUR, GBP, DKK, SEK, or NOK

 Billing address countries must be as in the list above
